items.title: OpenAI claims a matrix multiplication breakthrough
items.oneliner: OpenAI claims omega equals 9/4. If it holds, AI just moved from coding software to proving core complexity results.

items.title: GPT-6.2 beat human code golf records
items.oneliner: GPT-6.2 Astra scored 91.934% on go/codegolf, beating Googlers' 2015 record and shrinking the gap on algorithmic coding.

items.title: LoRA capacity got a sizing rule
items.oneliner: Engram says LoRA rank can be predicted from dataset demands, turning adapter sizing from guesswork into planning.

items.title: Sandboxed models found side channels
items.oneliner: Researchers showed sandboxed models can signal through inference servers, which makes multi-agent isolation look much less real.

items.title: Treasury subdomains were takeover-cheap
items.oneliner: Researchers hijacked US Treasury subdomains for $3 via dangling AWS DNS, exposing a painfully common cloud hygiene failure.

items.title: 1Password disclosed a backend breach
items.oneliner: 1Password says vaults stayed safe, but a compromised GitHub account exposed customer metadata and internal systems.

items.title: Hex.pm was hit by remote command execution
items.oneliner: Hex.pm blocked an RCE attack in under 20 minutes, but users should rotate passwords and expect stronger package signing.

items.title: Dutch regulators warned against AI glasses
items.oneliner: The Dutch privacy authority says do not buy AI camera glasses yet; safety failures and stealth recording crossed the line.

items.title: Rust's next trait solver is nearing release
items.oneliner: Rust 1.102 is set to ship the long-awaited next trait solver, turning a 2015 research thread into production compiler behavior.

items.title: Servo shipped a substantial browser update
items.oneliner: Servo 0.8.0 landed after 588 commits, adding video captions, ARIA improvements, and faster WebGPU paths.
